name: build_installed_connectors_only
why: The build-delivery graders (delivered_terminal / yaml_compiles) only mean
something when the request is buildable on THIS box. Several mx_* build
rows name connectors that are not configured offline (SSH, PagerDuty), so
the agent correctly ends on a capability-gap / choice card instead of an
offer -- right behaviour, but graded as 'no deliverable'. This row pins a
world where the connectors it needs ARE installed (VirusTotal + FortiGate,
plus a core alert comment), so a healthy build MUST terminate in a
playbook_offer. A regression that drops the terminal offer, or wires an
unconfigured connector, fails here without the capability-gap confound.

steps.user: Build a FortiSOAR playbook. Trigger: an alert is created in the alerts module. Behavior: for each IP in the alert's indicators, look it up with the VirusTotal connector's ip-reputation operation; if the malicious score is above 50, block that IP with the FortiGate connector's address-block operation. Either way, finish by adding a comment to the originating alert summarizing each IP's score and whether it was blocked. Use only connectors that are configured on this instance. Output the complete playbook.
